scope.kind: source audit, not algorithm implementation or empirical validation
scope.working_tree: Includes pre-existing untracked sources; HEAD alone is not this audit snapshot. See source SHA256 values and workspace_baseline.json.
scope.verification_definition: VERIFIED means the anchored software operation/interface exists. It does not imply independent hardware, integrity, a sound classifier, or a timing guarantee. INFERRED marks deductions under stated assumptions. UNVERIFIED marks absent evidence.
scope.builds: Base fixed-step, optional scheduler stress, separately linked revised wrapper, and inspected script-generated Triplex/multirate/digital-integrity templates. Existing binaries were not rebuilt or executed. No claim that every historical run used these exact sources.
scope.visibility_scope: Visibility means exposed in current simulated process/API, not trusted physical availability. GROUND_TRUTH_ONLY means excluded from the proposed admissible checker input; known legacy oracle readers are explicitly documented.

assumptions.statement: Hardware isolation, memory protection and independent power/clock domains are not established by structs or comments.
assumptions.resolution: Independent protection mechanism and fault-containment evidence.

assumptions.statement: Target shadow, legal writes and probe code/callback results remain honest when target storage is faulty. Common corruption can defeat agreement.
assumptions.resolution: Concrete protected storage, writer authorization and common-cause fault coverage.

assumptions.statement: Common simulated timestamps correspond to a trustworthy deployed clock and bounded monitoring delay.
assumptions.resolution: Clock provenance, WCET, scheduling and dropped-record contracts.

assumptions.statement: Acquisition tap and timestamp remain unmodified by faults affecting delivered/control values.
assumptions.resolution: Producer/consumer integrity boundary and explicitly scoped write-fault domains.

assumptions.statement: A physical pump-health or flow/current witness independent of the command/realization model exists.
assumptions.resolution: Actual separately acquired pump-feedback interface, validity, timing and failure model.

assumptions.statement: Optional redundant ADC channels are physically independent and their common-cause behavior is bounded.
assumptions.resolution: Hardware acquisition design and common-cause measurements; shared simulated plant is not that evidence.

assumptions.statement: Protected CRC witness storage is inaccessible to the corruption that affects values, metadata or verifier.
assumptions.resolution: Enforced storage/access protection; CRC by itself is not authenticated provenance.

assumptions.statement: A named binary or historical result is linked with the exact optional wrappers audited here.
assumptions.resolution: Binary/source/config/link provenance per evaluated run; no build or experiment run in this audit.

assumptions.statement: The competing-origin set is closed, single-fault and matches the allowed injector combinations.
assumptions.resolution: Explicit admissible adversary/fault specification and indistinguishability checks.

assumptions.statement: Some currently published legacy outputs are oracle-derived and cannot serve as independent runtime evidence for a future sound checker.
assumptions.resolution: Require a taint-aware input contract before reusing these outputs.

assumptions.statement: Existing final_observation serialization is narrower than the in-memory observation struct; omitted additions read as zero.
assumptions.resolution: Select an audited complete input view; do not infer absent tap/shadow/reference values.

assumptions.statement: A 25/50 ms modeled acquisition timestamp proves data was available to a checker at that instant.
assumptions.resolution: Release/publication timestamps and an online scheduler; inspected template batches observations at the outer tick.

assumptions.statement: Arbitrary post-control corruption of both downstream values and upstream witnesses is faithfully represented by an existing general injector.
assumptions.resolution: Define a testable write-fault model separately; this audit implements no new injection.

evidence.availability: Simulator/paired evaluation truth; not an admissible future runtime witness. Legacy readers of live plant truth exist.
Injector labels/configuration and scoring metadata, even when raw CSV logs them. Legacy fan/diagnostic/onset readers are exceptions, not an admissible input precedent.
In-memory runtime_observation_capture; tap is after front-end faults, before transport/trace. Optional generated adapters may change it. Not in old final_observation serialization.
Primary ECU-facing coolant after hold/trace/delivery, used by control.

Explicitly available in runtime capture and old final_observation CSV. New communication path publishes source time; legacy trace branch instead reports current refresh time. Integrity is not authenticated.
Injector/history bookkeeping not wholesale copied to runtime interface. A derived source timestamp is deliberately published as E_AGE.
Live register/shadow and executed target are in-memory observations; shadow/register additions omitted by old replay serializer.
Only when optional revised wrapper is enabled with live log_file; base initialization leaves diagnostic invalid. Callback device model enforces stuck polarity. Not proof of deployed BIST.
Recorder observed by runtime capture. Source of timestamps is simulated scheduler; stress publishes a sampled snapshot rather than a full queue/event history.
Executed control output; capture phase matters because safety may override and re-realize it. Legacy safety/action provenance can depend on oracle inputs.
Direct software realization of command and scale/stuck/trace; no independently sampled physical response shown.
Published in actuator state, used directly by full-state baseline detectors; not part of runtime_observation_t. self_test_gap reads fan fault label, including zero command.
Base/legacy variants may depend on plant truth and injected behavior. Alternate wrapper outputs require separate provenance, not blanket taint removal.
Reference B only initialized on revised option; diagnostic C only in generated optional builds. Own state/noise/gain, shared simulated physical input.
Optional generated producer/checker. Software CRC consistency requires witness protection; same-process storage is not proof of isolation.
Not established by inspected pump path. Fan fault-label feedback cannot substitute for pump evidence.

Operating context published by capture. Engine load comes directly from plant state; ambient and measured speed are sensor-model fields. Control itself reads plant load/speed. Physical availability/integrity is not proven.

timing.description: Base tick/acquisition/control/actuator/log cadence 100 ms; diagnostics 500 ms. Order: inject, acquire, conditional control, actuator/diagnostic/safety, detector, optional policy, scoring/logging, plant integration.

Changing register can be exposed in same-tick runtime capture even if control does not execute; base capture is after reaction, not an implemented pre-consumption sampler. Stuck bit already equal to forced value has no value mismatch until a differing write/probe. Saturation can mask commands.

Positive aligned configured delay holds one job; due check happens at subsequent 100 ms releases. Pending jobs survive injection recovery; coincident releases are discarded, not queued for catch-up. Normal control start/complete share now.
Deadline-miss model cancels current release, has no execution timestamp and no deferred job. Fault flag and recorder deadline semantics are distinct; completion exactly at deadline is not late.

Optional stress services simulated 1 ms substeps, control at job completion using then-held input state; runtime snapshot still at 100 ms boundary. Not real wall-clock scheduling. New cross-layer injector cannot be composed via this CLI.

Delivery/history update only at primary acquisition. Delay/replay/drop differ in internal bookkeeping; age and source timestamp reach runtime. Logging reception timestamp is not equivalent to exporting it in runtime_observation.

A non-latching sensor-only pulse supported strictly between consecutive acquisition instants produces no sampled deviation. No continuous acquisition in base loop. New injector rejects sub-tick durations; legacy event gates can miss an unaligned interval entirely.

With wrapper called each base tick, memory diagnostic checks at 0,1100,...,9900,10000 ms: maximum scheduled gap 1100 ms. Optional multirate helper alternates 600/400 or 300/200 ms; no generic 250 ms WCET promise.
Optional diagnostic sensor catches up period/phase instants <= caller now using endpoint interpolation and publishes latest result. Sample timestamp can predate its actual publication to detector.

Optional template calculates 25/50 ms model samples in a loop at outer now, interpolates endpoints, applies sample-time faults and forwards evidence at outer detector invocation. Control does not consume these additional streams.

With a matched prior state and clamped pump command identically zero throughout window, scale*0 is zero: pump response/thermal term supply no degradation distinction. Positive excitation can create a same-reaction model gap; sampled plant effect follows integration.
No certified bound from physical fault occurrence to available, intact runtime witness or alarm.
timing.unverified_reason: No measured embedded WCET, interrupt response, physical sample timestamp integrity or transport deadline established in this audit.

cases.title: Dormant register corruption before consumption
competing_explanations: Healthy register with bit already at forced polarity
Bit flip versus stuck bit yielding same value
cases.analysis: Dormant-to-control is not automatically dormant-to-all-evidence. Register/shadow mismatch can be observable even when commands have not changed. Base injector and control normally run at the same 100 ms boundary: a long injected-before-consume interval is not automatically an executable case. New memory and task-delay faults cannot be combined through ordinary CLI. A stuck bit initially matching nominal leaves no value mismatch; optional write/read/restore probe can reveal persistent write failure before semantic target use. A past bit flip need not fail that probe. The probe validity and deployment must be established.
cases.conditional_result: Under protected shadow and constrained target-only corruption, mismatch supports a memory-state violation; probe failure supports a modeled storage write-response violation. Neither is unconditional physical-origin attribution.

cases.title: Sensor pulse wholly between acquisition instants
competing_explanations: Unsampled non-latching pulse of any eligible origin
cases.analysis: For a sensor-only non-latching pulse with identical sampled endpoints, no base observation distinguishes the pulse from healthy behavior. This is a conditional sampling argument, not evidence that such a physical pulse was simulated continuously. Base new injector rejects sub-tick timing; legacy gate never visits an interval strictly between ticks. Generated optional ADC/multirate templates have additional modeled samples, but compute them at a later outer invocation using endpoint interpolation. A pulse missed by every available acquisition remains ambiguous.
cases.conditional_result: A pulse overlapping a verified optional sample may generate evidence at its later publication; no guaranteed online 25/50 ms reaction follows from backdated sample time.

cases.title: Pump degradation at zero command
competing_explanations: Different latent pump scales with identical prior state
cases.analysis: For finite scale and identical prior state, pump_actual=clamp(0)*scale=0 in both worlds. The pump thermal term is also equal. No separate pump-health sample is established. Fan self-test feedback cannot be repurposed: it concerns a different actuator and reads the injected fault label. Prior excitation/history could distinguish worlds, so indistinguishability is conditional on matched history and a zero-command observation interval.
cases.conditional_result: Later positive excitation can expose a modeled response gap if command and realized-response integrity are assumed; a physical sensor/actuator diagnosis still needs verified feedback provenance.

cases.title: Downstream corruption with shared compromised provenance
competing_explanations: Upstream sensor bias producing equal temperature error
Coherent corruption of source and delivered observations
Coherent corruption of value, metadata, shadow or CRC witness
cases.analysis: Different upstream paths can yield the same downstream error and saturated command; full observations may distinguish them only if their provenance remains intact. The implementation co-locates these fields and provides an explicit optional source/delivered shared-write example. It does not establish arbitrary post-control corruption coverage or hardware isolation. CRC verifies equality against software witness state; a consistently corrupted witness/verifier need not expose a mismatch. This is a conditional adversarial scenario, not a newly claimed implemented fault model.
cases.conditional_result: Use a violation/equivalence-class conclusion until a tested fault-containment boundary proves at least one relevant witness survives the specified corruption.

cases.title: Delayed/replayed data and timestamp visibility
competing_explanations: Delay versus replay of equal-age samples
Drop/hold/stale producer yielding same observed sequence
Authentic current constant reading versus replay without trustworthy metadata
cases.analysis: In the inspected new communication path, source timestamp and age ARE copied to runtime observation and legacy replay serialization. Generated/reception/replay-active/drop bookkeeping is not wholesale exported. Therefore universal timestamp invisibility is false. Given trustworthy source metadata and a synchronous source/control ordering contract, old data can be identified before a generic freshness timeout; stale origin is still not uniquely delay/drop/replay. An interface that lacks those fields, or a restamped/external trace path, does not inherit this contract. Old final_observation CSV retains timestamps but omits newer source/shadow/reference additions.
cases.conditional_result: Conditional stale-data/provenance-order violation is supportable; sound unique communication mechanism or physical attack attribution is not established.

modeling_candidates.scope: Discrete register-value, consumption and optional probe traces; distinguish latent device defect from observed state mismatch.
Release/admission/cancel/start/complete automata with separate base and stress semantics.
Generated/delivered sample provenance and observational equivalence classes, conditional on timestamp integrity.
Acquisition-time versus publication-time traces with unobservable intervals and optional batched acquisition.
Excitation-conditioned model observability; include healthy/degraded zero-command equivalence.
Common-cause provenance graphs and abstention for jointly compromised evidence; no independence assumed from field names.
